name: resin_text2sql_unified_eval
description: Unified end-to-end evaluation for deterministic SQL, RSL generation, temporal queries, safety, capability boundaries, and conversation memory.

turns.question: 查询原始材料密度最低的5个样本，返回样本编号和原始密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, rhov_i FROM material_static ORDER BY rhov_i ASC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 哪7个样本的碳化材料密度最高？请同时显示样本编号和碳化密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, rhoc_i FROM material_static ORDER BY rhoc_i DESC LIMIT 7

turns.question: 帮我找出原始孔隙率最大的6个样本，只需要样本编号。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id FROM material_static ORDER BY porosity_v DESC LIMIT 6

turns.question: 原始渗透率大于0的样本中，按原始渗透率从高到低取前10条，返回样本编号和原始渗透率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, permeability_v FROM material_static WHERE permeability_v > 0 ORDER BY permeability_v DESC LIMIT 10

turns.question: 我想查看原始材料密度在380到420之间的样本，返回样本编号、原始密度和原始孔隙率，最多15条。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, rhov_i, porosity_v FROM material_static WHERE rhov_i BETWEEN 380 AND 420 LIMIT 15

turns.question: 查一下碳化密度大于340且碳化孔隙率小于0.65的样本，显示样本编号、碳化密度和碳化孔隙率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, rhoc_i, porosity_c FROM material_static WHERE rhoc_i > 340 AND porosity_c < 0.65

turns.question: 查询碳化渗透率高于2e-12的样本，返回样本编号、碳化渗透率和碳化孔隙率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, permeability_c, porosity_c FROM material_static WHERE permeability_c > 2e-12

turns.question: 请找出原始密度低于350且原始渗透率大于9e-14的样本，最多返回20条。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, rhov_i, permeability_v FROM material_static WHERE rhov_i < 350 AND permeability_v > 9e-14 LIMIT 20

turns.question: 查询样本305的全部静态材料参数。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, rhov_i, rhoc_i, porosity_v, porosity_c, permeability_v, permeability_c FROM material_static WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000305'

turns.question: sample_000126的原始密度和原始孔隙率分别是多少？
turns.gold_sql: SELECT rhov_i, porosity_v FROM material_static WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000126'

turns.question: 请返回样本460的所有热物性参数。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, kv_list, kc_list, cpv_list, cpc_list, pyrolysis_heat, surface_emissivity FROM material_thermal_property WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000460'

turns.question: 查询原始导热系数最高的5个样本，只显示样本编号和原始导热系数。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, kv_list FROM material_thermal_property ORDER BY kv_list DESC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 请找出碳化导热系数最低的7个样本，并返回样本编号、碳化导热系数和热解热。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, kc_list, pyrolysis_heat FROM material_thermal_property ORDER BY kc_list ASC LIMIT 7

turns.question: 哪些样本的热解热大于230000且表面发射率低于0.9？返回样本编号、热解热和表面发射率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, pyrolysis_heat, surface_emissivity FROM material_thermal_property WHERE pyrolysis_heat > 230000 AND surface_emissivity < 0.9

turns.question: 查询原始比热容在1100到1140之间的样本，同时返回样本编号、原始比热容、碳化比热容和表面发射率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, cpv_list, cpc_list, surface_emissivity FROM material_thermal_property WHERE cpv_list BETWEEN 1100 AND 1140

turns.question: 找出表面发射率最低的5个样本，同时返回样本编号、表面发射率和原始密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.surface_emissivity, ms.rhov_i FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id ORDER BY mtp.surface_emissivity ASC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 哪8个样本的热解热最高？请显示样本编号、热解热、碳化密度和碳化孔隙率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.pyrolysis_heat, ms.rhoc_i, ms.porosity_c FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id ORDER BY mtp.pyrolysis_heat DESC LIMIT 8

turns.question: 查询原始比热容最大的4个样本，返回样本编号、原始比热容和原始孔隙率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.cpv_list, ms.porosity_v FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id ORDER BY mtp.cpv_list DESC LIMIT 4

turns.question: 帮我列出碳化比热容最低的6个样本，同时显示它们的原始密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.cpc_list, ms.rhov_i FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id ORDER BY mtp.cpc_list ASC LIMIT 6

turns.question: 表面发射率在0.85到0.90之间的样本有哪些？返回样本编号、发射率和碳化密度，最多10条。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.surface_emissivity, ms.rhoc_i FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id WHERE mtp.surface_emissivity BETWEEN 0.85 AND 0.90 LIMIT 10

turns.question: 请查看样本305的热解热、表面发射率、原始密度和碳化密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.pyrolysis_heat, mtp.surface_emissivity, ms.rhov_i, ms.rhoc_i FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id WHERE mtp.sample_id = 'sample_000305'

turns.question: 找出原始密度最高的10个样本，并同时返回它们的热解热和表面发射率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT ms.sample_id, ms.rhov_i, mtp.pyrolysis_heat, mtp.surface_emissivity FROM material_static ms JOIN material_thermal_property mtp ON mtp.sample_id = ms.sample_id ORDER BY ms.rhov_i DESC LIMIT 10

turns.question: 查询碳化孔隙率最低的5个样本，同时显示原始比热容和碳化比热容。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT ms.sample_id, ms.porosity_c, mtp.cpv_list, mtp.cpc_list FROM material_static ms JOIN material_thermal_property mtp ON mtp.sample_id = ms.sample_id ORDER BY ms.porosity_c ASC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 哪些样本同时满足原始密度大于400、热解热大于225000、表面发射率大于0.88？返回样本编号和这三个字段，最多12条。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT ms.sample_id, ms.rhov_i, mtp.pyrolysis_heat, mtp.surface_emissivity FROM material_static ms JOIN material_thermal_property mtp ON mtp.sample_id = ms.sample_id WHERE ms.rhov_i > 400 AND mtp.pyrolysis_heat > 225000 AND mtp.surface_emissivity > 0.88 LIMIT 12

turns.question: 按表面发射率从高到低排列，取前6个样本，并显示样本编号、发射率、原始密度和原始孔隙率。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.surface_emissivity, ms.rhov_i, ms.porosity_v FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id ORDER BY mtp.surface_emissivity DESC LIMIT 6

turns.question: 查询原始导热系数最低的8个样本，同时返回它们的碳化导热系数和碳化密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.kv_list, mtp.kc_list, ms.rhoc_i FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = mtp.sample_id ORDER BY mtp.kv_list ASC LIMIT 8

turns.question: 查询样本305从point_index 0到20的表面温度、背面温度和质量，按point_index升序排列。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT point_index, surface_temperature, back_temperature, mass FROM thermal_response WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000305' AND point_index BETWEEN 0 AND 20 ORDER BY point_index ASC

turns.question: 帮我查看样本481在point_index 100到120之间的背面温度变化，只返回point_index和背面温度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT point_index, back_temperature FROM thermal_response WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000481' AND point_index BETWEEN 100 AND 120 ORDER BY point_index ASC

turns.question: 查询sample_000032前15个序列点的表面温度、背面温度和质量。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT point_index, surface_temperature, back_temperature, mass FROM thermal_response WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000032' ORDER BY point_index ASC LIMIT 15

turns.question: 请返回样本126在point_index等于500时的表面温度和背面温度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT surface_temperature, back_temperature FROM thermal_response WHERE sample_id = 'sample_000126' AND point_index = 500

turns.question: 找出峰值背面温度最低的5个样本，返回样本编号和峰值背面温度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, MAX(back_temperature) AS peak_back_temperature FROM thermal_response GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY peak_back_temperature ASC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 查询峰值表面温度最高的10个样本，并显示对应的样本编号和峰值表面温度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, MAX(surface_temperature) AS peak_surface_temperature FROM thermal_response GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY peak_surface_temperature DESC LIMIT 10

turns.question: 哪5个样本的平均背面温度最高？请返回样本编号和平均背面温度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, AVG(back_temperature) AS average_back_temperature FROM thermal_response GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY average_back_temperature DESC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 请列出平均表面温度最低的6个样本，只显示样本编号和平均表面温度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, AVG(surface_temperature) AS average_surface_temperature FROM thermal_response GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY average_surface_temperature ASC LIMIT 6

turns.question: 找出最终质量最低的8个样本，最终质量按每个样本最大的point_index对应记录计算。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT tr.sample_id, tr.mass AS final_mass FROM thermal_response tr JOIN (SELECT sample_id, MAX(point_index) AS max_point_index FROM thermal_response GROUP BY sample_id) latest ON latest.sample_id = tr.sample_id AND latest.max_point_index = tr.point_index ORDER BY tr.mass ASC LIMIT 8

turns.question: 找出原始比热容最高的3个样本，同时返回它们各自的背面温度峰值。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT mtp.sample_id, mtp.cpv_list, MAX(tr.back_temperature) AS peak_back_temperature FROM material_thermal_property mtp JOIN thermal_response tr ON tr.sample_id = mtp.sample_id GROUP BY mtp.sample_id, mtp.cpv_list ORDER BY mtp.cpv_list DESC LIMIT 3

turns.question: 哪些样本的峰值表面温度大于1300，同时碳化密度大于330？返回样本编号、峰值表面温度和碳化密度。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT tr.sample_id, MAX(tr.surface_temperature) AS peak_surface_temperature, ms.rhoc_i FROM thermal_response tr JOIN material_static ms ON ms.sample_id = tr.sample_id WHERE ms.rhoc_i > 330 GROUP BY tr.sample_id, ms.rhoc_i HAVING MAX(tr.surface_temperature) > 1300

turns.question: 计算每个样本的质量损失率，并返回质量损失率最高的5个样本。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT first_row.sample_id, (first_row.mass - last_row.mass) / first_row.mass AS mass_loss_rate FROM thermal_response first_row JOIN (SELECT sample_id, MIN(point_index) AS first_point, MAX(point_index) AS last_point FROM thermal_response GROUP BY sample_id) bounds ON bounds.sample_id = first_row.sample_id AND bounds.first_point = first_row.point_index JOIN thermal_response last_row ON last_row.sample_id = bounds.sample_id AND last_row.point_index = bounds.last_point ORDER BY mass_loss_rate DESC LIMIT 5

turns.question: 按sample_id和point_index升序查询thermal_response表中的全部数据。
turns.gold_sql: SELECT sample_id, point_index, surface_temperature, back_temperature, mass FROM thermal_response ORDER BY sample_id ASC, point_index ASC LIMIT 200
